info.title: PURPS API
info.description: Everything purps.lol can do, as JSON. Read the coin list, a coin's full page and the launchpad; launch coins on purps.lol, pump.fun and Pons; wire an existing pump.fun coin's fees into a strategy; steer a coin you own. No key, no signup. A launch is one call that returns unsigned transactions: the launch transaction can only land with your wallet's signature, and that is the proof. The few writes that need a message signature (Pons launches, wiring a strategy onto a coin, creator authority) come as a prepare/submit pair. Every transaction is signed in your wallet, never by us. Every response is `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`. Cross-origin requests are allowed from any site. Cacheable reads carry `RateLimit-Limit` and `RateLimit-Policy`; uncached responses (writes, prepare and submit, refusals) carry `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` as well.

post.description: One call, no message to sign. Send the launch's terms, the coin's image and socials. We upload the metadata, build the launch transaction (and a SOL-to-pair swap in front of it when the pair is not SOL and there is a dev buy), simulate it, and record the launch as pending. You get back unsigned transactions and the throwaway mint key. The launch transaction can only land with the creator wallet's signature, and that is the proof: sign each transaction with the creator wallet, and the one at `createIndex` with the mint key as well, then send them in order through /transactions/send. The launch goes live on its own once the pool exists on chain; poll /launches/{mint}. A wallet the launchpad does not admit is refused with a 403 before anything is uploaded; a wallet that cannot afford the launch (about 0.03 SOL plus the dev buy) with a 400. `imageUrl` fetches are budgeted (20 an hour per address, 200 an hour site-wide); a 429 naming image fetches means send `image` as a data URL instead.

post.description: Step 1: the message to sign with your EVM wallet (`personal_sign`, EIP-191). Pons is the one launchpad that still signs a message before the build, because launching there is invite-only and the signature is how the invite is checked before anything is spent. The message carries a `launches:` line that spells the launch out in words: name, ticker, pair, creator tax and first buy. Send `devBuy` and `creatorTaxBps` here too when you will send them to submit; they are part of those words.

post.description: Step 1 of a change through creator authority. Say which wallet will sign and what it will do (`kind`: act on a position, change the strategy, ask for authority, or hand the coin on), and get back the exact message to sign plus a `nonce` bound to this coin, this wallet and this exact action. The message is plain English and is the consent: it says what will happen (`does:` or `sets:`) and carries your `why:` note, which holders read on the Changes tab. Sign exactly that string. Nothing is stored or spent here; every check that guards money runs at submit, on the server's own figures. This step only refuses what can never work: the flagship (403), a coin that is not a purps.lol launch or has no strategy yet (404), a frozen coin (423), a request while authority is closed to new coins (403) or already on (409), a malformed action, config or note (400), or a server with signing not set up (503).

post.description: Step 2: the same body as prepare, plus `ts`, `nonce` and the wallet's `signature` over the message prepare returned (ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes, base58). The signer must be the wallet named in prepare: the coin's owner, which is whoever holds its creator rewards, or a platform admin wallet. The nonce only fits the wallet, coin and exact action it was issued for, and a signature is good once. Every money check runs here on the server's own figures, so a change the coin page would refuse is refused here too. An `action` is queued for the engine and answers `queued` with the command id; watch /coins/{mint}/changes for done or failed, and /coins/{mint} for the position. A `strategy` change is applied at once and answers `changed`, the lines that differ. A `request` answers the request's `id` and `status`. A `handover` answers the new `payoutWallet`. Refusals: 401 for a bad signature, a nonce not issued for this wallet and action, or a timestamp older than five minutes; 403 when authority is not on for the coin; 409 when the coin is not live, the market already has an action running, nothing changed, or the signature was already used; 422 when a money check refuses it, with the reason; 423 frozen; 429 for the per-day action count or a cooldown still running; the reason says how long.

rewardMode.description: What profits do: `burn` (default), `holders` pays the coin itself, `backed` pays `payoutMint`. Paying coins need `holderPayoutsEnabled` in /launch-options.

payoutMint.description: `backed` only: the asset holders are paid in. On Solana, a mint from /launch-options `payoutAssets` or any Solana mint with a real market. On Robinhood Chain, a `0x` token address that passes the depth check: one of the launchpad's `payoutAssets`, or any token /pons/assets/{address} reports as payable. ETH itself cannot be a payout asset there.

pons.description: Pons on Robinhood Chain. Payout assets carry `address` instead of `mint`.

presets.description: The site's strategy presets, the same on every launchpad, each with the exact `config` fields to send.

airdropOnly.description: The config for a coin that only pays holders and holds no perps: the whole fee to the buyback, no legs. Set `payoutMint` for a backed asset, or leave `rewardMode` as holders for the coin itself.

access.description: `{ openToAll, allowedWallets }`. When not open to all, only the listed wallets may launch here.

pairs.description: Where this launchpad's pairs are listed: `{ from: "/pairs", key, note }`. Read `/pairs` and take the list under `key`.

fees.description: The launchpad's fee terms: purps.lol has `platformBps`, `creatorFeeBps { min, max, default }` and `raiseTargetSol`; Pons has `creatorTaxBps { min, max, default }`.

payoutAssets.description: What holders can be paid in on this launchpad, as the create page lists them.

payoutNote.description: What else is accepted beyond the list, and how it is checked.

sells.description: How it takes profit, in words.

buys.description: How it handles dips, in words.

config.description: Merge into your Strategy: the three splits, the `strategy` tuning object, and `legReserveMode`, the `reserveMode` to set on every leg (`none` when the preset keeps no reserve). Add your own `perpLegs`, `rewardMode` and payout mints.

mint.description: purps.lol and pump.fun: use as `payoutMint` or in `payoutMintsExtra`.

address.description: Robinhood Chain: use as `payoutMint` or in `payoutMintsExtra`.

market.description: purps.lol and pump.fun: the perp market it backs, e.g. `AAPL`.

strategyBps.description: Share swapped to SOL and fed into the coin's strategy.

airdropBps.description: Share paid to holders in the pair token from the airdrop pot.

creatorBps.description: Share sent straight to the creator wallet, in the pair token.

LaunchBuild.description: A purps.lol launch, in one call. No `ts` or `signature`: the launch transaction you sign is the proof.

feePreset.description: Where creator fees go: `airdrop` to holders in the pair token, `split` half to holders half to you, `creator` all to your wallet, `strategy` into a strategy you send now. Send `feeSplit` for any other share.

feeSplit.description: Optional three-way share of the creator fee, basis points summing to 10000. `strategy` is required when `strategyBps` is above zero.

devBuySol.description: Your own first buy, in SOL. Converted to the pair on the way in when the pair is not SOL. Default 0.

creatorFeeBps.description: Your fee tier, basis points of curve volume, on top of the platform's 1%. Default 100 (1%); 50 (0.5%) to 980 (9.8%).

strategy.description: Required when `feePreset` is `strategy` or `feeSplit.strategyBps` is above zero. Checked before anything is uploaded; registered by us the moment the launch goes live.

creatorWallet.description: The Solana wallet that signs the transactions and pays.

image.description: The coin's logo as a data URL (`data:image/png;base64,…`). PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 512KB max. Send this or `imageUrl`.

imageUrl.description: A public https link to the logo instead of `image`. Fetched by us under the same size and type rules.

description.description: Up to 500 characters. The coin's website in its metadata is always its purps.lol page; add your own links as `twitter` and `telegram`.

PumpLaunchBuild.description: A pump.fun launch, in one call. No `ts` or `signature`: the create transaction you sign is the proof.

quoteMint.description: A pair from /pairs `pumpfun`. Omit for SOL. A custom pair needs `customPairAccess` in /launch-options.

devBuySol.description: Your own first buy, in SOL. Default 0.

creatorWallet.description: The Solana wallet that signs the transactions and pays.

image.description: The coin's logo as a data URL (`data:image/png;base64,…`). PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 512KB max. Send this or `imageUrl`.

imageUrl.description: A public https link to the logo instead of `image`. Fetched by us under the same size and type rules.

description.description: Up to 500 characters. The coin's website in its metadata is always its purps.lol page; add your own links as `twitter` and `telegram`.

creatorWallet.description: The coin's on-chain creator, who will sign.

done.description: True when the fees are already routed and there is nothing to sign.

transaction.description: Base64 transaction to sign and send, when not done.

transactions.description: Base64 transactions to sign and send in order.

createIndex.description: Which of `transactions` is the create. Sign that one with the mint key as well.

mintSecret.description: The mint keypair's secret, base58. Powerless after the launch; use it once to countersign the create.

confirmed.description: Whether it confirmed within the wait. If false, poll /transactions/{signature}.

feeWallet.description: The PURPS wallet its fees must be routed to.

feeShareBps.description: How much of the creator fee reaches the strategy, in basis points.

registered.description: Whether a strategy is registered here.

name.description: Fallback name if the chain has none.

symbol.description: Fallback ticker if the chain has none.

imageUrl.description: Fallback logo if the chain has none.

registered.description: True once the strategy is attached.

feeWallet.description: When not registered: where the fees must go first.

creator.description: When not registered: who the fees currently go to.

pairToken.description: A pair from /pairs `pons`. Omit or the zero address for ETH.

creatorWallet.description: The EVM wallet that signs and sends.

devBuy.description: Your own first buy, in ETH, as a decimal string. Part of the signed words when sent, so send the same value to submit.

creatorTaxBps.description: A creator tax on every trade, basis points, up to 2000. Default 0. Part of the signed words when sent, so send the same value to submit.

image.description: The coin's logo as a data URL (`data:image/png;base64,…`). PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 512KB max. Send this or `imageUrl`.

imageUrl.description: A public https link to the logo instead of `image`. Fetched by us under the same size and type rules.

description.description: Up to 500 characters. The coin's website in its metadata is always its purps.lol page; add your own links as `twitter` and `telegram`.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over the prepared message. Base58 on Solana, 0x-hex on Robinhood Chain.

steps.description: Transactions to send in order: `{ label, tx: { to, data, value, chainId } }`.

walletKey.description: Keep this: the register step needs it.

feeRecipient.description: The PURPS wallet the coin's fees will go to.

requiredWei.description: ETH the wallet needs for the whole flow, in wei.

shortByWei.description: `0` when the wallet can afford it.

pair.description: The pair the coin trades in.

registered.description: The registered coin's address, or null.

catalogue.description: True when it is one of the site's listed pairs.

creatorWallet.description: The wallet that sent the launch.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over the prepared message. Base58 on Solana, 0x-hex on Robinhood Chain.

registered.description: True once the strategy is attached.

alreadyRegistered.description: True when this launch had a strategy attached before this call; nothing changed.

curve.description: The Pons curve contract the coin trades on, on a fresh registration.

reason.description: When not registered: why not yet (`launch not confirmed yet`, `launch not indexed yet`, or the chain has no record of the transaction).

dropped.description: When not registered: true when the chain has no record of the transaction at all, so retrying will not help; false when it is simply not confirmed yet.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over the prepared message. Base58 on Solana, 0x-hex on Robinhood Chain.

available.description: Whether this coin can be steered from outside at all: a purps.lol launch, not the flagship, with a strategy wired.

reason.description: When not available: why (`this coin is never steered from outside`, `not a launchpad coin`, `the coin has no strategy yet`).

state.description: `off` until the platform turns it on for the coin, `on` while the owner may steer it, `frozen` when an admin has stopped everyone.

owner.description: The wallet that owns the coin: whoever holds its creator rewards. The launching wallet until a handover, then whoever it was handed to.

openToPublic.description: Whether the platform is accepting requests for creator authority right now.

pendingRequest.description: Whether a request for authority on this coin is waiting for review.

cooldowns.description: Timers still running after a recent change, each `{ key, since, until }` with ISO 8601 times. `key` is `MARKET:kind` for one leg (e.g. `ETH:leverage`) or a bare kind for the coin as a whole.

marginHold.description: Money parked on the exchange for a re-entry after a close or trim: `{ usdc, until }`. Null when nothing is parked.

limits.description: The platform's limits on what an owner may do.

maxLeverage.description: The most leverage an owner may set, whatever the market allows.

actionsPerDay.description: Position actions allowed per coin in a rolling day.

cooldownMinutes.description: How long a market, or the coin, waits after a change before the next.

minDayVolumeUsd.description: A market must have traded this much in the last day to be moved into.

minOpenInterestUsd.description: A market must carry this much open interest to be moved into.

maxShareOfOiBps.description: A position may be at most this share of the market's open interest, in basis points.

noteLength.description: `{ min, max }` characters for the `note` on an action or strategy change.

wallet.description: The owner's wallet. Null for an admin: their address is never published.

summary.description: The change in one line, as the Changes tab shows it.

status.description: `applied` for a strategy or controls change; a position action is `queued` for the engine, then `done` or `failed`.

note.description: The owner's reason, from the signed words.

OwnerAction.description: One action on one position. `action` picks the shape; the other fields depend on it. `close` { market, margin }. `trim` { market, pct, margin }. `swap` { market, to, direction, leverage }. `open` { market, direction, leverage, usdc? }. `leverage` { market, leverage, method, profit? }. `margin` { market, usdc, direction }. A market is one of the coin's legs (or, for `swap`, the `to` market is any market from /markets on the coin's venue).

market.description: The leg to act on, e.g. `ETH`. 1 to 32 characters of letters, digits, `:`, `_` or `-`.

margin.description: `close` and `trim`: where the freed margin goes. `hold` parks it on the exchange for seven days for a re-entry; `home` pays it out through the buyback road.

pct.description: `trim`: how much of the position to close, 1 to 99 percent.

to.description: `swap`: the market to move into. The same market with the other `direction` is a flip.

direction.description: `swap` and `open`: `long` or `short`. `margin`: `add` moves money from the reserve into the position, `remove` moves it back.

leverage.description: `swap`, `open` and `leverage`: a whole number, 1 to 50, within the market's cap and the platform's `maxLeverage`.

usdc.description: `margin`: the dollars to move, at most 100000, in cents. `open`: how much of the parked money to open with; all of it when absent.

method.description: `leverage`: `resize` keeps the margin and buys or sells part of the position; `margin` keeps the size and moves money in or out of the reserve.

profit.description: `leverage` with `resize`, when lowering: the profit on the part sold goes `home` like any close, or stays in the position as margin with `keep`. The creator's share is paid either way.

wallet.description: The Solana wallet that will sign: the coin's owner (from /coins/{mint}/authority), or a platform admin wallet.

kind.description: `action` acts on one position. `strategy` replaces the coin's whole strategy. `request` asks for creator authority on a coin from before it existed. `handover` hands the creator rewards, and the authority, to another wallet.

config.description: `strategy` only: the whole new config. Sent byte-for-byte the same to submit; its hash is in the message.

note.description: `action` and `strategy`: required, 3 to 140 characters on one line, your reason. It is in the signed words and holders read it. `request`: optional, up to 500 characters on one line. `handover`: none.

payoutWallet.description: `handover` only: the wallet to hand the coin to. A plain wallet, not the coin's own wallet or a platform wallet.

ts.description: Unix seconds. Send it back unchanged.

nonce.description: Starts with `api.`. Bound to this coin, this wallet and this exact action; good once; five minutes. Send it back unchanged.

message.description: The exact text to sign: ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes, no prefix, no hashing. It reads as plain English (`does:` or `sets:` says what will happen, `why:` is your note) and is the consent.

hash.description: The hash of the action or config, as embedded in the message. Null for `request` and `handover`.

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the signature stays valid. 300.

signature.description: The wallet's ed25519 signature over `message`, base58.

queued.description: `action`: the id of the command queued for the engine. Watch /coins/{mint}/changes for done or failed.

changed.description: `strategy`: the lines that differ from before, as the Changes tab shows them.

payoutWallet.description: `handover`: the wallet that now holds the rewards. Null when handed back to the launching wallet.
